A forming grade designed for vertical or light duty horizontal interior applications requiring radiused edges. Thinner than Grade 12; excellent for postformed radii. Contact adhesive is not recommended for Grade 20 panels wider than 24" (610mm).

texture_description: This linear or rift cut grain with subtle ticking is a perfect compliment to modern straight grain woods. The Woodbrush texture features a high/low luster combination giving complexity and depth. Recommended for horizontal or vertical interior application. Available on all Solid Colors and select Woodgrains. Vertical texture.
grade_description: Horizontal Postforming Grade (HGP). Outside radius to 5/8" (15.9mm) and cove radius to 3/16" (4.8mm). Postformable to permit bending on suitable commercial postforming equipment. Use whenever forming is desired for decorative or functional purposes in interior applications. Optimum postforming temperature is 325°F (163°C).

grade_description: Vertical Postforming Grade (VGP). Outside and inside radii to 1/2" (12.7mm). A forming grade designed for vertical or light duty horizontal interior applications requiring radiused edges. Thinner than Grade 12; excellent for postformed radii. When using Grade 20, finished panel widths should not exceed 24" (610mm) maximum, unless the adhesive system is a rigid rod adhesive like PVA (wood glue). Contact adhesive is not recommended for Grade 20 panels wider than 24" (610mm).
